name: Hadad
overview: The name Hadad appears in Scripture referring to multiple individuals connected to Edom and Israel's history. One Hadad, son of Bedad, succeeded Husham as king of Edom after defeating the Midianites in the field of Moab, establishing his rule in the city of Avith. Another Hadad, also called Hadar, succeeded Baal-hanan as king of Edom and ruled from Pau. Additionally, Hadad the Edomite was raised among the king's lineage and became an adversary to Solomon, illustrating the ongoing tensions between Edom and Israel during Solomon's reign. These accounts highlight Hadad's significance as both a political leader and a figure involved in the broader narrative of God's dealings with His people.
